item.title: Musk Is Right About Power, But the Next Power System May Not Be in Orbit
item.description: As SpaceX bets on orbital data centers, Envision Group's desert AI campuses in Inner Mongolia are already serving customers — moving AI to where renewable energy is abundant.

item.title: MiniMax H3 Open Weights: Video, Audio and Motion, Finally in One Workflow
item.description: MiniMax's H3 model now ships open weights, with text, image, video and audio fused as context and native stereo sound output up to 15 seconds at 2K. Community benchmarks show the 768p Base model running on consumer GPUs in minutes.

item.title: China's First 100,000-Card Domestic AI Super-Cluster Goes Live, and the National Compute Grid Takes Shape
item.description: A fully domestic 100,000-card AI super-cluster came online this month at the National Supercomputing Internet Zhengzhou core node, with a parallel deployment in the Greater Bay Area. The NDRC is now framing the next five-year plan around a single national compute fabric.

item.title: Inside Bengbu's Sensor Valley: How a Single City Built a Domestic Sense Stack from MEMS Chips to BCI
item.description: Bengbu, a second-tier industrial city in Anhui province, has quietly assembled one of China's most complete domestic sensor stacks — 8-inch MEMS wafer production, flexible BCI electrodes, and clinical applications across stroke rehab and Alzheimer's screening.

item.title: Why DeepSeek Could Charge 30x More and Still Be the Cheapest Model Around
item.description: Third-party platforms are pricing DeepSeek V4 Flash below official rates. A price hike of 30x would still leave DeepSeek the cheapest major model, and its near-perfect cache-hit rate is the engineering moat that keeps the headline number honest.
